measurement.payload_utf8_bytes: Actual compact UTF-8 serialized provider payload size in bytes.
measurement.estimate: Payload UTF-8 bytes + 256 + 64 * message count; offline estimate units, not tokenizer tokens or billing.
measurement.required_estimate: Same formatter applied to mandatory candidate blocks only.

invariants.non_instruction_candidate_blocks: All keys, source, roles, required, priority, order and message hashes unchanged, including state, memory, lore, history, trace and current evidence.
invariants.normal_budget: Context ceilings, input allowances and output reserves unchanged.
invariants.diagnostic_budget: required_only follows the new required estimate; overflow uses required estimate minus one. These diagnostic allowances intentionally differ; production budget settings do not.
invariants.selection: Optional included/excluded blocks may change solely because shorter instructions leave more budget; original candidate text and priority are unchanged.

limitations: No provider generation/count calls, live responses, latency, token usage or quality scores were collected.
Offline invariants and byte reductions do not establish character, coherence, repetition, state/boundary, memory or appraisal quality.
Larger final payloads may result from retaining additional optional history; compare required estimates and selection separately.

In long_context EN, retained history_2 displaces optional guidance_3_trust, lore and examples; RU instead adds examples but still retains no history pair. These are budget tradeoffs, not demonstrated quality improvements.
Consent/evidence/format violations in live responses remain unevaluated, not zero.
Final retain/rework/reject quality decision remains pending an explicitly authorized bounded live comparison.
